name: Eric Barlow
summary:
Eric Barlow (born May 8, 1966) is an American politician who is the governor-elect of Wyoming. He was a Republican member of the Wyoming Senate since 2023, and before that he was the speaker of the Wyoming House of Representatives from 2021 to 2023, and a member of the chamber representing District 3 from 2013 to 2023.
Barlow won the 2026 Wyoming gubernatorial election to succeed Mark Gordon.
